value.value: All laboratory samples are measured using Rigaku SmartLab Cu Kalpha1 radiation with Bragg-Brentano optics; Fullprof performs Rietveld refinement. Initial structural models are literature ICSD entries ZnAl2O4 39473, ZnO 26170 and AlOOH 59608, not new source-provided coordinate files.
